public interface WsRejectionHandlingStrategy
Rejection handling strategy for WS transactions.

Dmytro Rud

    void
    handleRejectedExchange(Exchange cxfExchange)
    This method will be called when the request has been rejected by CXF (in this case, the CXF exchange will contain a SOAP fault) or by IPF (transaction-specific logic).
    boolean
    isRejected(Exchange cxfExchange)
    This method should return true when the given CXF exchange can be considered rejected (failed).

  • Method Details

    • handleRejectedExchange

      void handleRejectedExchange(Exchange cxfExchange)
      This method will be called when the request has been rejected by CXF (in this case, the CXF exchange will contain a SOAP fault) or by IPF (transaction-specific logic).
      Parameters:
      cxfExchange - CXF exchange containing multiple representations of the request message and the whole context information.

    • isRejected

      boolean isRejected(Exchange cxfExchange)
      This method should return true when the given CXF exchange can be considered rejected (failed).

      Parameters:
      cxfExchange - CXF exchange under consideration.
      Returns:
      true when the given CXF exchange has been rejected; false otherwise.
      See Also:
      • SoapUtils.extractOutgoingException(Exchange)
